Selection List for Chandraprabha Saikiani Women Hostel of Pandu College (Autonomous) for
                             the academic session 2026-2027
   The following PG students are eligible for taking admission at Chandraprabha Saikiani Women
Hostel of Pandu College (Autonomous), Pandu, Guwahati-781012 for the academic session 2026-
2027.
     The selected students must deposit an amount of Rs.17,000.00 as admission fees in the
following bank details through Internet Banking/NEFT /RTGS/Account transfer /UPI in favour of
Principal, Pandu College on or before 18/08/2026 without fail and deposit the payment
receipt to the hostel superintendent.
       Further the seats remaining vacant after 18/08/2026 will be filled up from the waiting
list.
